Head_and_Face: Head is small and barely distinct from the body with large, dark eyes adapted for low-light vision.
Dark mask-like marking extending from the eye to the corner of the mouth, creating a banded appearance across the face.
Pupils are round.
Body_and_Plumage: Body is slender and cylindrical.
Dorsal coloration is pale grey, tan, or light brown with dark brown or black blotches running the length of the body.
Blotches are irregular and more prominent on the anterior portion.
Ventral surface is pale cream to white with small dark spots on the lateral edges of ventral scales.
Scales are smooth and glossy with a slight iridescent sheen.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Body is slender with a thread-like diameter relative to length.
Tail is short and blunt.

Head_and_Face: Head is broad and triangular with a blunt snout and large, dark eyes with vertical slit pupils.
Heat-sensing pits are present on the upper lip scales.
Body_and_Plumage: Body is massive and heavily-built cylindrical.
Dorsal coloration is tan, brown, or grey with distinctive dark brown or reddish-brown saddle-shaped blotches.
Blotches are diamond or hourglass-shaped with lighter centers, creating a bold, geometric pattern.
Ventral surface is pale cream to white.
Scales are smooth and glossy with a highly reflective surface.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Body is extremely robust and muscular, adapted for constriction.
Tail is relatively short with a prehensile tip.

Head_and_Face: Head is broad and triangular with a blunt snout, large dark eyes with vertical slit pupils.
Heat-sensing pits on the upper and lower lip scales.
Body_and_Plumage: Body is massive and robust cylindrical.
Dorsal coloration is light brown or tan with large, irregular dark brown blotches forming a reticulated (net-like) pattern.
Blotches are irregularly shaped with lighter margins.
Ventral surface is pale cream to white.
Scales are smooth and glossy with a highly reflective surface.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Body is extremely thick and muscular with a massively robust diameter disproportionate to typical snake proportions.
Tail is relatively short and prehensile.

Head_and_Face: Head is broad and distinct from the neck with large, dark eyes and round pupils.
Body_and_Plumage: Body is slender and cylindrical.
Dorsal coloration is variable: olive, brown, grey, or black with or without lighter crossbands.
Most characteristic marking is the spectacle (spectacle-shaped or monocled pattern) on the dorsal surface of the expanded hood.
Ventral surface is pale cream to white.
Scales are smooth and glossy.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Most distinctive feature is the expandable neck hood.
When threatened, elevates the anterior third of the body and expands the neck ribs to form a wide, flattened hood.
Tail is short and blunt.

Head_and_Face: Head is narrow and elongated with a prominent brow ridge creating a slightly coffin-shaped profile when viewed from above.
Eyes are large and dark with round pupils.
Body_and_Plumage: Body is slender and elongated.
Dorsal surface is uniformly bright emerald green with smooth, glossy scales.
Ventral surface is pale yellow-green to white.
Uniform green coloration with no patterning.
Scales are smooth and highly glossy with a reflective surface.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Body is laterally compressed, adapted for arboreal locomotion.
Tail is long and prehensile.

Head_and_Face: Head is small and barely distinct from the body with a blunt snout and small eyes with round pupils.
Nostrils are positioned dorsally and can be closed during submersion.
Body_and_Plumage: Body is laterally compressed and eel-like.
Coloration varies: common patterns include banded (black and white or black and yellow), uniformly grey or olive, or bicolored (dark dorsally, pale ventrally).
Scales are smooth and glossy with small, overlapping scales creating a sleek surface.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Most distinctive feature is the laterally compressed, paddle-shaped tail comprising the posterior quarter of body length.
Body is cylindrical anteriorly but becomes increasingly laterally compressed toward the tail.

Head_and_Face: Head is broad and triangular with a blunt snout.
Most prominent feature is the pair of horn-like scales above each eye (elongated, horn-like supraocular scale projecting upward and backward).
Eyes are small with vertical slit pupils.
Body_and_Plumage: Body is stout and cylindrical.
Dorsal coloration is pale yellow, tan, or grey with dark brown or black zigzag or diamond-shaped blotches.
Scales are strongly keeled (ridged) creating a rough, matte texture.
Ventral surface is pale cream to white.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Tail is short and blunt.

Head_and_Face: Head is broad and triangular with a blunt snout.
Heat-sensing pits between the eye and nostril.
Eyes have vertical slit pupils.
Body_and_Plumage: Body is massive and robust cylindrical.
Dorsal coloration is tan, brown, or grey with numerous dark brown diamond-shaped blotches running the length of the body.
Each diamond is outlined in lighter scales with a darker center, creating a bold geometric pattern.
Scales are strongly keeled (ridged) creating a rough, textured appearance.
Ventral surface is pale cream to white with dark mottling.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Body is extremely robust and muscular.
Most distinctive feature is the rattle at the tip of the tail, composed of interlocking keratinous segments.
Tail is short with the rattle comprising the terminal portion.

Head_and_Face: Head is broad and triangular with a blunt snout.
Heat-sensing pits between the eye and nostril.
Prominent supraocular scale projecting above each eye creating a horned appearance.
Eyes are small with vertical slit pupils.
Body_and_Plumage: Body is slender relative to other rattlesnakes.
Dorsal coloration is pale tan, cream, or light grey with numerous dark brown or reddish-brown blotches.
Blotches are rounded or slightly diamond-shaped with lighter margins.
Scales are strongly keeled (ridged) creating a rough texture.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Rattle is small and composed of few segments.
Unique sidewinding locomotion: moves by throwing loops of its body sideways in a series of J-shaped curves.

Head_and_Face: Cephalon (head) is semi-circular to triangular with a pair of compound eyes positioned dorsolaterally.
Eyes are composed of calcite lenses.
Body_and_Plumage: Exoskeleton is calcified and divided longitudinally into three lobes: a central axial lobe and two lateral pleural lobes.
Exoskeleton surface is smooth or ornamented with spines, tubercles, or ridges.
Body is dorsoventrally flattened.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Thorax consists of multiple articulated segments, each with a central ring and lateral extensions, enabling enrollment (curling into a ball) for defense.
Pygidium is composed of fused segments forming a shield-like tail plate.
Multiple pairs of biramous (two-branched) appendages beneath the body.
